title: bRMS Generator Researcher
description: Windows desktop application that generates breaking repeated masking suppression (bRMS) experiments for Green Lab at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem. It writes a JSON experiment file for a separate bRMS runner. Release 1.2.1 is an archival snapshot of the GitHub repository tip.

creators.name: Weisler, Nadav
creators.affiliation: Shalvata Mental Health Center; Data Research Center for Mental Health and Rehabilitation, Clalit; Psychology Department, Hebrew University of Jerusalem
